dialogues.speaker: Koloman
dialogues.text: Sure is. Doesn't even pay that well, and I've got to leave before the sun comes up, and get home long after it sets. Whether I leave my house or go back into it, my kid's fast asleep...

dialogues.speaker: Koloman
dialogues.text: Maybe in a few years, I'll find that I've raised a child who doesn't remember my face at all...
